text: 2026年10月30日，中国人民银行党委书记、行长潘功胜主持召开党委会议。会议强调，继续实施适度宽松的货币政策，综合运用多种货币政策工具，保持流动性充裕。做好金融“五篇大文章”，加快建设多层次现代化金融市场体系，提升金融服务实体经济适配性，更好支持经济转型升级和增长动能转换。有力有效防范化解重点领域金融风险。扩大金融高水平开放，推进人民币国际化，加快建设和发展多渠道、广覆盖的人民币跨境支付体系。坚定维护国家金融安全。
text_en: On October 30, 2026, Pan Gongsheng, Party Secretary and Governor of the People's Bank of China, chaired a Party Committee meeting. The meeting emphasized the need to continue implementing a moderately loose monetary policy, comprehensively use various monetary policy tools, and maintain ample liquidity. It called for advancing the "five major articles" of finance, accelerating the development of a multi-tiered modern financial market system, enhancing the adaptability of financial services to the real economy, and better supporting economic transformation and upgrading and the shift in growth drivers. It also urged vigorous and effective efforts to prevent and defuse financial risks in key areas, expand high-level financial opening, advance RMB internationalization, accelerate the development of a multi-channel, broad-coverage cross-border RMB payment system, and resolutely safeguard national financial security.
